meta.side: contingent liabilities (off-budget) — NOT part of the budget total
meta.headline: Gujarat's outstanding guarantees: ₹1,421 cr — 0.65% of revenue receipts; ₹18,579 cr headroom under the ₹20,000 cr ceiling. Outside the on-budget total — the part of the books the budget does not show.
meta.off_budget_note: SFAR 2024-25 §3.1 names the mechanism: borrowing routed through SPSUs to bypass the XV-FC 3%-of-GSDP Net Borrowing Ceiling; GoI now reduces a state's ceiling by the extent of off-budget borrowing. §3.2: undischarged liabilities (₹70.76 cr unpaid deposit interest, cess/NPS short-transfers). State represented to MoF it has no off-budget liabilities.
meta.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year 2024-25, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 2 of 2026)
meta.caveat: Contingent liabilities, not budget spending — a charge on the Consolidated Fund only if a guarantee is invoked. NOT part of the on-budget total. Source: CAG SFAR (ex Finance Accounts Statement 20). RBI 'State Finances' guarantees statement = pending cross-check.
